Support Program Increment (PI) planning activities by refining features and user stories, identifying dependencies and risks, and contributing to meaningful business outcomes. Manage and continuously refine the team backlog to balance customer value, business priorities, technical requirements, quality improvements, and team capacity. Develop clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting requirements that enable effective and efficient software delivery. Help teams understand the customer impact and business value behind planned functionality, enabling informed prioritization and decision-making. Gather and incorporate customer and stakeholder feedback to enhance usability, reliability, and overall product experience. Collaborate across development, quality, architecture, operations, and security teams to coordinate work, address dependencies, and support successful delivery outcomes. Review completed work against defined acceptance criteria and intended business results, leveraging feedback and lessons learned to improve future planning. Communicate effectively with global stakeholders, providing clarity on priorities, progress, risks, and key decisions. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of Agile practices, team collaboration, and delivery effectiveness.
